newsitem.title: FINLAND: ICE HOCKEY-WORLD CHAMPIONSHIPS TO BE EXPANDED.
newsitem.headline: ICE HOCKEY-WORLD CHAMPIONSHIPS TO BE EXPANDED.

text.p: The International Ice Hockey Federation (IIHF) said on Friday that it would increase the number of teams for next year's world championship from 12 to 16.

"We want to open up the world championship to other countries," said IIHF president Rene Fasel. "The next championship will have a team from the Far East, Japan and the host country Switzerland will also be guaranteed a place."
The top 11 teams from this year's championship, plus Switzerland, Japan, B pool champions Belarus and two more teams from a qualifying tournament will make up next year's tournament.
The 16 teams will be divided into four groups of four, the top two in each advancing to the medal round.
IIHF officials said the addition of four more teams would not add to the length of the championship which this year runs for almost three weeks.
